description: This Java source file defines an enumeration called Permission, representing different permission levels (READ, WRITE, ADMINISTRATE) for the Ditto framework. It includes methods to concatenate all permissions into a string and to convert a permission to a JsonKey.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: An enum representing various permissions within Ditto, including methods to convert permissions to string and JSON key representations.

methods.name: allToString
methods.description: Concatenates all Permission enum values into a formatted string, separated by commas, and enclosed in angle brackets.

methods.name: toJsonKey
methods.description: Converts a Permission enum value into a JsonKey object.
